title: BsaI Type IIS Cloning into pCk Vectors
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.92gh8bw

steps.title: Determine DNA plasmid concentrations
steps.instruction: Determine the concentrations of the required L0 plasmids and the pCk acceptor plasmid using spectrophotometry (Nanodrop).

steps.title: Prepare plasmid aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare aliquots of the plasmids at specific concentrations: 15 nM for L0 plasmids and 7.5 nM for the acceptor pCk vector.

substeps.instruction: To calculate ng/μL for 15 nM: Divide plasmid length in bp (N) by 110 (approximation of 15∙10^(-9)mol/L x ((607.4 x N ) + 157.9)g/mol x 10^(-6)L/μL x 10^9ng/g).
To calculate ng/μL for 7.5 nM: Divide plasmid length in bp (N) by 220.

steps.title: Prepare Loop assembly Level 1 master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Loop assembly Level 1 reaction master mix (MM) according to the provided table.

substeps.instruction: If assembling more than 4 L0 parts, reduce the water volume in the MM by 1 μL for each extra 1 μL of DNA part added to the plasmid mix.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid mix
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL tube, combine the plasmids to create a plasmid mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μL of each L0 plasmid.
Add 1 μL of the pCk vector.
Add sterile water up to a final volume of 5 μL (if 4 L0 parts are used, no water is added).

steps.title: Combine master mix and plasmid mix
steps.instruction: Add 5 μL of the master mix (MM) to the 5 μL of plasmid mix to reach a final volume of 10 μL and mix well.

steps.title: Perform thermocycler program
steps.instruction: Place samples in a thermocycler and run the following program:

substeps.instruction: Assembly: 26 cycles of 37 °C for 3 min and 16 °C for 4 min.
Termination and enzyme denaturation: 50 °C for 5 min and 80 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Transform E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Transform chemically competent E. coli cells (efficiency of 1 × 10^7 transformants/µg plasmid DNA).

substeps.instruction: Use 2 μL of the Loop assembly reaction to transform 20 μL of cells.
Plate on LB agar plates containing 50 μg/mL kanamycin and 40 μg/mL of X-gal for blue-white screening.

steps.title: Incubate and screen colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C and identify colonies by color.

substeps.instruction: Identify white colonies as likely containing the L1 insert cloned into the pCk vector.
Identify blue colonies as containing undigested pCk vector with LacZ.

steps.title: Confirm insert via Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Confirm the presence of the correct insert using Sanger sequencing with the appropriate primers.

substeps.instruction: For pCk vectors: use primers pC_F (GCAACGCTCTGTCATCGTTAC) and pC_R (GTAACTTAGGACTTGTGCGACATGTC).
For pCkchlo vectors: use primers pC_F and pC_R2 (CAATCTGCTCTGATGCCGCATAGTTAAG).
